content.comment_body: Hello! Is there a way to add a background picture in [product_name]? This would make it easier to manage and organize the blocks.
Could you clarify what you mean? I am not sure I understand your question.
I would like to add a schematic as a background, such as a house plan, so that I can place the blocks in the corresponding rooms.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for an option to add custom background images, like schematics or plan drawings, into the [product_name] workspace. This would help them visually organize logic blocks by physical location, improving spatial orientation and management within the design software. It is not clear at this stage if the feature is available.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to insert their own background images, such as schematics or layout plans, into the [product_name] interface to better visualize and arrange logic blocks according to physical spaces.
